name: Default
shortDescription: ESPHome Device Builder dashboard for writing YAML configs, compiling firmware and updating ESP32, ESP8266, BK72xx and RP2040 devices.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated ESPHOME_PASSWORD from the environment variables. Signed-in users can run arbitrary code at compile time, so keep the password private.

Without host networking the dashboard cannot use mDNS: devices are not discovered and .local names do not resolve. Flash the first install from your browser over USB, and give each device a fixed address reachable from this server (use_address or manual_ip) for status and OTA updates.
